strategy.thesis: EU-funded Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology, running a portfolio of pan-European acceleration programmes (Bridgehead, InnoStars Awards, Jumpstarter, Startup Amplifier) that take health, medtech, digital-health and biotech founders from idea to scale-up.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Network of universities, hospitals, corporates and research institutes across Europe; runs pre-acceleration (Jumpstarter), cross-border scaling (Bridgehead) and CEE/Southern-Europe-focused (InnoStars) tracks.

program.location: Pan-European, central office in Munich, Germany

summary.en: EIT Health is the EU's Knowledge and Innovation Community for health, headquartered in Munich, running multiple accelerator programmes across Europe for biotech, medtech and digital-health startups.

strategy.thesis: Novartis's global network of digital-health innovation labs, giving external health-tech startups access to Novartis clinical/regulatory/legal expertise, data sandboxes (2M+ patient-years of trial data) and, in some cases, direct investment — without requiring equity.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Provides data sandboxes linked to Novartis clinical trial data and cross-functional business partnering (legal, privacy, regulatory, quality, IT).
